title: Merging is the lead's; pushing follows the project's convention
situation: The operator, 2026-10-15, confirmed after two read-backs: the workflow becomes intent-based delegation instead of a prescribed procedure. The open question was who pushes a cut's branch and when the lead integrates; a lead's run ended before the architect's acceptance.
decision: The lead merges each approved pull request that passes every check as its task ends, so nothing waits on the architect's acceptance; the architect accepts the story on its outcome. Pushing to the shared repository follows the project's convention; in cratylus it needs the operator's say-so, which an operator's confirmation of a change can give for the pushes that change needs.
consequences: Settles the open question; no merge waits on the end of a story.
